author: JKawesome
body:
Hey! So seanfrogz and I decided to make another urban themed map. Netox_max helped a little at the end. It features 3 monuments, one under each beacon. Map download will be provided after I complete the YML.













To-do list:
✗ Make the monuments more challenging
✓ Add some structures in the middle
✗ Make map bigger
✗ Monuments too close to spawn
✓ Change stone slabs to something less plain
✓ Round out the edges of the road
✓ Give ground some shape, not flat
✗ Add some lamps
✓ Void under water
